description: This file contains utility functions for managing allowlists, including deduplication, merging, resolution summaries, canonicalization, patching config entries, and mapping summarization, specifically for allowlist user resolution data.

methods.name: dedupeAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries from a list of allowlist strings, normalizing by trimming and case-insensitive comparison.

methods.name: mergeAllowlist
methods.description: Merges existing allowlist entries with new additions, deduplicating the combined list.

methods.name: buildAllowlistResolutionSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of resolved and unresolved allowlist user entries, including mappings and additions.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistIdAdditions
methods.description: Generates a list of allowlist IDs from existing entries based on a resolved map.

methods.name: canonicalizeAllowlistWithResolvedIds
methods.description: Converts allowlist entries to their canonical form, resolving IDs where possible, and deduplicating.

methods.name: patchAllowlistUsersInConfigEntries
methods.description: Updates configuration entries with resolved allowlist user IDs, using specified strategies.

methods.name: addAllowlistUserEntriesFromConfigEntry
methods.description: Adds allowlist user entries from a config entry to a target set, ignoring wildcards.

methods.name: summarizeMapping
methods.description: Logs a summary of allowlist mappings and unresolved entries.
